Abelian_Variety.title: Abelian Variety
Abelian_Variety.define: An abelian variety is a complete algebraic group variety, central in arithmetic geometry.

Affine_Space.title: Affine Space
Affine_Space.define: An affine space is a geometric space with no distinguished origin.

Algebra_Structure.title: Algebra Structure
Algebra_Structure.define: An algebraic structure is a set equipped with operations whose behavior is controlled by specified axioms.

Automorphic_Form.title: Automorphic Form
Automorphic_Form.define: An automorphic form is a highly symmetric complex-valued function on an arithmetic quotient of a reductive group.

Banach_Space.title: Banach Space
Banach_Space.define: A Banach space is a normed vector space in which every Cauchy sequence converges.

Bessel_Function.title: Bessel Function
Bessel_Function.define: Bessel functions are special functions that naturally arise as radial solutions of differential equations with cylindrical symmetry.

Binary_Tree.title: Binary Tree
Binary_Tree.define: A binary tree is a rooted tree in which each node has at most two children.

Bipartite_Graph.title: Bipartite Graph
Bipartite_Graph.define: A bipartite graph is a graph whose vertices can be split into two parts so that every edge connects the two parts.

Boolean_Algebra.title: Boolean Algebra
Boolean_Algebra.define: Boolean algebra is an algebraic structure that formalizes logical operations such as and, or, and not.

Branching_Process.title: Branching Process
Branching_Process.define: A branching process models a population in which each individual reproduces randomly and independently.

Brownian_Motion.title: Brownian Motion
Brownian_Motion.define: Brownian motion is the continuous Gaussian process with stationary independent increments.

Chain_Complex.title: Chain Complex
Chain_Complex.define: A chain complex is a sequence of modules or vector spaces linked by differentials whose successive composition is zero.

Complete_Graph.title: Complete Graph
Complete_Graph.define: A complete graph is a graph in which every pair of distinct vertices is connected by an edge.

Complex_Field.title: Complex Field
Complex_Field.define: The complex field extends the real numbers by adjoining a square root of $-1$.

Cone.title: Cone
Cone.define: A cone is a subset closed under multiplication by positive scalars.

Convex_Set.title: Convex Set
Convex_Set.define: A convex set is a subset that contains the line segment joining any two of its points.

Cubic_Function.title: Cubic Function
Cubic_Function.define: A cubic function is a polynomial function whose highest-degree term has degree three.

Differential_Manifold.title: Differential Manifold
Differential_Manifold.define: A smooth manifold is a space that locally looks like $\mathbb R^n$, and whose overlapping coordinate systems transform smoothly into one another.

Diffusion_Process.title: Diffusion Process
Diffusion_Process.define: A diffusion process is a Markov process with continuous sample paths.

Dirac_Delta_Function.title: Dirac Delta Function
Dirac_Delta_Function.define: The Dirac delta is a generalized function that represents unit mass concentrated at a single point.

Directed_Acyclic_Graph.title: Directed Acyclic Graph
Directed_Acyclic_Graph.define: A directed acyclic graph is a directed graph with no directed cycles.

Dirichlet_Character.title: Dirichlet Character
Dirichlet_Character.define: A Dirichlet character is a periodic multiplicative arithmetic function modulo an integer.

Dirichlet_Series.title: Dirichlet Series
Dirichlet_Series.define: A Dirichlet series is a complex-valued function given by a series of the form $\sum a_n n^{-s}$.

Elliptic_Curve.title: Elliptic Curve
Elliptic_Curve.define: An elliptic curve is a smooth projective genus-one curve with a chosen rational point, equivalently an abelian variety of dimension one.

Elliptic_Integral.title: Elliptic Integral
Elliptic_Integral.define: Elliptic integrals are integrals involving square roots of cubic or quartic polynomials that generally cannot be expressed by elementary functions.

Euclidean_Space.title: Euclidean Space
Euclidean_Space.define: Euclidean space is the standard model of flat finite-dimensional geometry.

Exponential_Function.title: Exponential Function
Exponential_Function.define: The exponential function is the function whose rate of change is proportional to its current value.

Fiber_Bundle.title: Fiber Bundle
Fiber_Bundle.define: A fiber bundle is a space that locally looks like a product of a base space with a typical fiber.

Field.title: Field
Field.define: A field is an algebraic structure where addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division by nonzero elements are all possible.

Filtered_Probability_Space.title: Filtered Probability Space
Filtered_Probability_Space.define: A filtered probability space is a probability space equipped with an increasing family of sigma-algebras representing information over time.

Fourth_Order_Function.title: Fourth Order Function
Fourth_Order_Function.define: A fourth-order function is a polynomial function whose highest-degree term has degree four.

Fractal.title: Fractal
Fractal.define: A fractal is a geometric object whose structure exhibits detail across scales, often through self-similarity.

Function.title: Function
Function.define: A function assigns each input exactly one output.

Galois_Representation.title: Galois Representation
Galois_Representation.define: A Galois representation is a homomorphism from a Galois group into a linear group over a coefficient field.

Gamma_Function.title: Gamma Function
Gamma_Function.define: The Gamma function extends the factorial function from positive integers to complex and real arguments.

Gaussian_Process.title: Gaussian Process
Gaussian_Process.define: A Gaussian process is a stochastic process whose every finite family of coordinates is jointly Gaussian.

Global_Field.title: Global Field
Global_Field.define: A global field is either a number field or a function field of one variable over a finite field.

Graph.title: Graph
Graph.define: A graph is a structure made of vertices and edges that records pairwise relationships.

Group.title: Group
Group.define: A group is an algebraic structure that captures reversible composition with an identity element.

Hausdorff_Space.title: Hausdorff Space
Hausdorff_Space.define: A Hausdorff space is a topological space in which any two distinct points can be separated by disjoint neighborhoods.

Hilbert_Space.title: Hilbert Space
Hilbert_Space.define: A Hilbert space is a complete inner product space where geometric notions such as length and angle support limits.

Holomorphic_Function.title: Holomorphic Function
Holomorphic_Function.define: A holomorphic function is a complex function that is complex differentiable in a neighborhood of every point of its domain.

Hypergeometric_Function.title: Hypergeometric Function
Hypergeometric_Function.define: Hypergeometric functions are special functions defined by power series whose coefficient ratios are rational functions of the index.

Inner_Product_Space.title: Inner Product Space
Inner_Product_Space.define: An inner product space is a vector space with a product that defines length, angle, and orthogonality.

Integer_Ring.title: Integer Ring
Integer_Ring.define: The integer ring is the set of integers with usual addition and multiplication.

Knot.title: Knot
Knot.define: A knot is an embedding of a circle in three-dimensional space, studied up to continuous deformation.

L_Function.title: L Function
L_Function.define: An $L$-function is a complex analytic object that encodes arithmetic data through Euler products, Dirichlet series, and functional equations.

Lattice.title: Lattice
Lattice.define: A lattice is an ordered set in which every pair of elements has both a greatest lower bound and a least upper bound.

Levy_Process.title: Levy Process
Levy_Process.define: A Levy process is a cadlag process with stationary independent increments.

Lie_Algebra.title: Lie Algebra
Lie_Algebra.define: A Lie algebra is a vector space equipped with a bilinear bracket satisfying antisymmetry and the Jacobi identity.

Lie_Group.title: Lie Group
Lie_Group.define: A Lie group is a group whose operations vary smoothly with respect to a manifold structure.

Linear_Function.title: Linear Function
Linear_Function.define: A linear function preserves addition and scalar multiplication.

Linear_Space.title: Linear Space
Linear_Space.define: A linear space is a set whose elements can be added and scaled by elements of a field.

Linear_Transformation.title: Linear Transformation
Linear_Transformation.define: A linear transformation is a structure-preserving map between vector spaces.

Local_Field.title: Local Field
Local_Field.define: A local field is a field complete with respect to a nontrivial discrete valuation and having finite residue field.

Logic.title: Logic
Logic.define: Logic studies formal languages, truth conditions, and inference rules for valid reasoning.

Manifold.title: Manifold
Manifold.define: A manifold is a space that may be globally curved or complicated but locally looks like Euclidean space.

Markov_Chain.title: Markov Chain
Markov_Chain.define: A Markov chain is a discrete-time Markov process.

Markov_Process.title: Markov Process
Markov_Process.define: A Markov process is a stochastic process whose future depends on the present state and not on the past history.

Martingale.title: Martingale
Martingale.define: A martingale is a stochastic process whose conditional future value equals its present value.

Measurable_Space.title: Measurable Space
Measurable_Space.define: A measurable space is a set equipped with a sigma-algebra specifying which subsets are measurable.

Measure_Space.title: Measure Space
Measure_Space.define: A measure space is a measurable space equipped with a measure assigning sizes to measurable sets.

Metric_Space.title: Metric Space
Metric_Space.define: A metric space is a set equipped with a distance function satisfying the basic rules of distance.

Mobius_Function.title: Mobius Function
Mobius_Function.define: The Mobius function is an arithmetic function that records the square-free prime factor structure of an integer.

Modular_Curve.title: Modular Curve
Modular_Curve.define: A modular curve is an algebraic curve that parametrizes elliptic curves equipped with level structure.

Modular_Form.title: Modular Form
Modular_Form.define: A modular form is a holomorphic function on the upper half-plane satisfying a specific transformation law and growth condition.

Module.title: Module
Module.define: A module is a vector-space-like structure whose scalars come from a ring rather than necessarily from a field.

Natural_Number.title: Natural Number
Natural_Number.define: Natural numbers are the discrete numbers used for counting and indexing.

Normed_Linear_Space.title: Normed Linear Space
Normed_Linear_Space.define: A normed linear space is a vector space equipped with a norm that measures vector length.

Number_Field.title: Number Field
Number_Field.define: A number field is a finite field extension of the rational numbers.

Ordered_Set.title: Ordered Set
Ordered_Set.define: An ordered set is a set where the elements can be compared to tell which comes before or after another.

Point_Process.title: Point Process
Point_Process.define: A point process is a random locally finite configuration of points.

Poisson_Point_Process.title: Poisson Point Process
Poisson_Point_Process.define: A Poisson point process is a point process with independent increments and constant intensity.

Poisson_Process.title: Poisson Process
Poisson_Process.define: A Poisson process is the counting process with stationary independent increments.

Polyhedron.title: Polyhedron
Polyhedron.define: A polyhedron is a solid in three-dimensional space bounded by finitely many polygonal faces.

Polynomial_Function.title: Polynomial Function
Polynomial_Function.define: A polynomial function is a function formed from powers of a variable using finitely many additions and scalar multiplications.

Prime.title: Prime
Prime.define: A prime number is a natural number greater than one whose only positive divisors are one and itself.

Probability_Distribution.title: Probability Distribution
Probability_Distribution.define: A probability distribution is the law induced by a random element on its state space.

Probability_Space.title: Probability Space
Probability_Space.define: A probability space is a measure space whose total measure is one.

Projective_Space.title: Projective Space
Projective_Space.define: Projective space is the space of lines through the origin of a vector space.

Quadratic_Function.title: Quadratic Function
Quadratic_Function.define: A quadratic function is a polynomial function whose highest-degree term has degree two.

Quaternion_Ring.title: Quaternion Ring
Quaternion_Ring.define: The quaternion ring extends complex numbers with three imaginary units whose multiplication is noncommutative.

Radon_Transform.title: Radon Transform
Radon_Transform.define: The Radon transform represents a function by its integrals over affine hyperplanes.

Random_Element.title: Random Element
Random_Element.define: A random element is a measurable map from a probability space into a measurable state space.

Random_Field.title: Random Field
Random_Field.define: A random field is a stochastic process indexed by a multidimensional parameter set.

Random_Variable.title: Random Variable
Random_Variable.define: A random variable is a real-valued random element.

Random_Walk.title: Random Walk
Random_Walk.define: A random walk is the partial-sum process of independent random increments.

Rational_Number_Field.title: Rational Number Field
Rational_Number_Field.define: The rational number field consists of ratios of integers with nonzero denominator under ordinary arithmetic.

Real_Field.title: Real Field
Real_Field.define: The real field is the complete ordered field that models the continuous number line.

Relation.title: Relation
Relation.define: A relation records which ordered tuples of elements are considered related.

Riemann_Zeta_Function.title: Riemann Zeta Function
Riemann_Zeta_Function.define: The Riemann zeta function packages the arithmetic of positive integers into a complex analytic function.

Riemannian_Manifold.title: Riemannian Manifold
Riemannian_Manifold.define: A Riemannian manifold is a smooth manifold equipped with a positive definite metric tensor.

Ring.title: Ring
Ring.define: A ring is an algebraic structure with addition, subtraction, and multiplication, where multiplication need not be commutative or invertible.

Scheme.title: Scheme
Scheme.define: A scheme is a space obtained by gluing together spectra of commutative rings.

Semimartingale.title: Semimartingale
Semimartingale.define: A semimartingale is the basic integrator class for modern stochastic calculus.

Sequence.title: Sequence
Sequence.define: A sequence is a function whose domain is usually the natural numbers, listing objects in order.

Set.title: Set
Set.define: A set is a collection of distinct objects considered as a single mathematical object.

Sheaf.title: Sheaf
Sheaf.define: A sheaf is a device for assigning local data to open sets in a way that can be uniquely glued from compatible local pieces.

Simplex.title: Simplex
Simplex.define: A simplex is the simplest convex polytope in a given dimension.

Spherical_Harmonics.title: Spherical Harmonics
Spherical_Harmonics.define: Spherical harmonics are special functions on the sphere that form angular modes for rotationally symmetric problems.

Stationary_Process.title: Stationary Process
Stationary_Process.define: A stationary process is a stochastic process whose law is invariant under time shifts.

Stochastic_Process.title: Stochastic Process
Stochastic_Process.define: A stochastic process is a family of random variables indexed by time or another parameter.

Stopping_Time.title: Stopping Time
Stopping_Time.define: A stopping time is a random time whose occurrence can be determined from the information available up to that time.

Symplectic_Manifold.title: Symplectic Manifold
Symplectic_Manifold.define: A symplectic manifold is a smooth manifold equipped with a closed nondegenerate differential 2-form.

Tensor.title: Tensor
Tensor.define: A tensor is a multilinear object that generalizes scalars, vectors, covectors, and linear maps.

Topological_Space.title: Topological Space
Topological_Space.define: Topological Space is a space in which open sets are defined.

Tree.title: Tree
Tree.define: A tree is a connected acyclic graph.

Vector_Bundle.title: Vector Bundle
Vector_Bundle.define: A vector bundle is a fiber bundle whose fibers are vector spaces and whose local trivializations are linear on fibers.

p_Adic_Number.title: p Adic Number
p_Adic_Number.define: The $p$-adic numbers form the basic characteristic-zero local field attached to a prime $p$.

Real_Valued_Function.title: Real Valued Function
Real_Valued_Function.define: A real-valued function assigns a real number to each point of its domain.

Real_Valued_Sequence.title: Real Valued Sequence
Real_Valued_Sequence.define: A real-valued sequence is an ordered family of real numbers indexed by the natural numbers.

Complex_Valued_Function.title: Complex Valued Function
Complex_Valued_Function.define: A complex-valued function assigns a complex number to each point of its domain.
